title: Turn a support issue into clearer help
description: Synthesize deduplicated support evidence into a draft enablement article and product-feedback proposal.
purpose: Draft a short help article and a product follow-up from support notes, ready for a teammate to review.
label: Support notes
example:
Open issue: A pilot reviewer found that an old saved answer contradicts the current product guide.

Still needed: The source owner has not approved a replacement answer.

Already resolved: Yesterday’s permissions issue is closed; it is not blocking the pilot.

This is a fictional example, not a real customer ticket.

support.metrics: No support aggregates or performance baseline supplied. Do not invent counts or outcomes.
support.taxonomy: Determine current issues only from supplied statuses. Resolved permissions history is not a current blocker.
support.guidance: Compare citations with approved current documentation, quarantine stale answers, assign a source owner, route uncertain claims for human review.
